scope: Independent read-only physics audit of proposal sources; no task mutations, paid jobs or resampling.

singlet_spin_branch_check.channel_rule: Static transfer equal-spin; static creation opposite-spin; driven transfer (-n,n); driven creation (n,n), including n=-1 when oscillator absorption opens it.

derivation.displacement: D=exp(i*sqrt(rho)*(b+b†)); oscillator number parity Pi sends D to D†. Thus <m+ell|D†|m>=(−1)^ell<m+ell|D|m>, giving conditional cross covariance (−1)^ell*Pell. Thermal reversal weights are P−ell=exp(−ell*w0/Tph)*Pell.
derivation.reverse_and_pair_channels: Define delta=n*w−ell*w0. Transfer ER=EL+delta; creation EL+ER=delta>gapL+gapR. Negative ell opens static opposite-spin and n=−1 down/down creation. Hermitian reverse annihilation is included once through net occupations with P−ell, rather than counted as a separate positive-energy creation channel.
derivation.spin_uniqueness: Each transfer contributes columns (−AL,sL*sR*AL) and (sL*sR*AR,−AR); each creation changes off-diagonal signs but keeps negative diagonal and equal magnitude. AL,AR>=0 for both forward/reverse weights. Positive finite-temperature local relaxation adds strictly negative diagonals. The integrated Jacobian between two candidate roots is strictly column diagonally dominant, hence nonsingular, proving uniqueness. At large polarization the normal-state linear part plus relaxation is positive definite; bounded recoil moments and finite gaps give sublinear corrections, establishing existence/coercivity.
derivation.many_weak_cells: For N independent noninterfering contact cells take conductance per cell G/N and bath linewidth/restoring rate proportional to N^(−1/2). Then tunnel/bath rate ratio→0 and linewidth/oscillator frequency→0, while total G stays fixed. Backaction and any dissipative coherent-pair terms vanish; static phase-controlled coherent Josephson current supplies no dc power. This ordering must be public, not an instantaneous reset of one cell carrying full G.
derivation.factorized_source: Conditional covariance matrix Pell*[[1,DW],[DW,1]] is positive semidefinite, retains detailed balance and correct oscillator probabilities, but drops charge-displacement/energy correlation. It is a coherent complete approximation, exact at rho0 and in the normal state, not an omitted channel or negative-rate model.
derivation.phase_protocol: Stationary spin populations must be solved separately at phi and phi+pi; holding the first populations in the second device changes the observable. Proposal code uses two independent stationary solves.
derivation.conservation: Each transfer or creation satisfies QL+QR+n*w−ell*w0=0. Every driven event injects total spin2n; static creation injects zero total spin, so stationary gate work equals kB*w*(IL+IR)/2. Forward-minus-reverse times log-forward-over-reverse is nonnegative. Adding local flip entropy and spin balance leaves −QL/TL−QR/TR+Qenv/Tph.

limitations: This approves the proposal physics, not a paid-model difficulty claim. Final actual task/public/source/reference/calibration consistency still requires a frozen-source review.

Sharp oscillator lines and equilibrium populations require the stated many-weak-cell ordering. A single oscillator carrying all conductance with zero linewidth would not justify this equilibrium bath approximation.

The reference uses independent Fock and 2x2 spin matrices but the same positive-energy integration changes as the prototype; direct exponentiation, closed signed-energy and thermodynamic anchors provide additional independent checks.
Production reference must be self-contained instead of importing immutable r4 prototype dependencies; phase-contrast groups must use nonzero RMS signals and individually re-equilibrated devices.
